name: estimate_swap_time
description: Estimate how long a crypto swap will take based on the source and destination blockchains. Use when a customer asks: 'How long will my swap take?', 'How long does BTC to ETH take?', 'Why is my swap slow?', 'How fast is a Solana swap?', 'What's the expected time for swapping?', 'Is Bitcoin swap slow?'. Extract the blockchain names from what the customer mentions.

from_chain.description: The source blockchain (e.g. btc, eth, sol, base, arb, ton, near, doge, ltc, xrp). Use the short code if possible.

to_chain.description: The destination blockchain (e.g. btc, eth, sol, base, arb, ton, near, doge, ltc, xrp). Use the short code if possible.

responsePrompt:
Present the time estimate in a reassuring, friendly way.

If specific chains were provided, explain:
- Deposit confirmation time (depositTime) — how long it takes for the source blockchain to confirm the deposit
- Delivery time (deliveryTime) — how long for the destination chain to deliver tokens
- Total estimated time (totalEstimate) — the combined wait

If Bitcoin is involved, mention that BTC is slower (~30 min) due to block confirmation times — this is normal. For fast chains like Solana, NEAR, or XRP, highlight they're usually done in about a minute.

If the customer seems worried about a slow swap, reassure them that these are estimates and the swap is still processing. If it exceeds the estimate significantly, suggest they check their order status.

If no chains were provided and you got the full table, summarize the fastest and slowest chains to give them a general idea.
